name: Monitor X Search with Xquik
description: Searches X with Xquik, normalizes matching posts, and builds an email-ready social listening digest.

setup: Workflow secret XQUIK_X_API_KEY: xquik.com X-API-Key credential for xquik.com (X-API-Key: <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.

hints: Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.

notes: Set XQUIK_API_KEY in n8n before running. This workflow reads it from $env and does not store the key.
